verdict.rationale: Plausible offers a read-only Stats API where /api/v2/query takes simple or complex queries and returns metrics as JSON, so an agent could pull key metrics and render its own dashboard. Plausible itself ships a single fixed dashboard (plus embedding), and the read-only API cannot create or configure dashboards, goals or reports inside the product. Missing for 10: an official MCP server, a write/configuration API for building dashboards or goals end-to-end, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt (both probes returned 404), and any hands-on evidence of an agent doing this.
